rationale: VERSION 2.2.0 -> 3.0.0: replaced six partly dead or dishonest numeric/palette controls with exact scene_profile and command_profile axes.; Rebuilt defaults around all five demonstrated motif/canvas D4 profiles, both demonstrated command multisets, monochrome motifs, all nonzero colors, and a small literal-public prior.; Removed the incorrect requirements that motif colors avoid 1..4, corner commands be unique, and all four transformed variants be distinct; those requirements rejected every public input.; Replaced intent-only self_check with strict ARC parsing, coordinate-based corner exclusion, connectivity/color/profile recognition, command-multiset classification, and exact returned-grid axis observation.; Added a broad input-pure Python mirror with masked corner exclusion, focused semantic/metamorphic/source tests, two 60,000-draw censuses, 60 negative cases, 500 live-Racket cases, and trainer-facing quality/visual evidence.
summary: Read the four corner cells in top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right order as transform commands: 1 rotates clockwise, 2 rotates 180 degrees, 3 flips left-right, and every other value takes the flip-up-down branch. Ignore those four cells by position, crop all remaining nonzero motif cells, transform the crop four times, and paste the variants into the corresponding quadrants of a padded 2-by-2 output.
